intro:

This Rummy-type game belongs to the Canasta family, where the objective is to lay down combinations in groups of cards of equal rank and suit sequences, with a bonus for combinations of seven cards or more. What sets Buraco apart from its competitors is its simplicity, accessibility, and the thrill of competing against another player in real-time. With no registration required, players can jump right into the action and experience the excitement of Buraco in a matter of minutes. Whether you're a seasoned card game enthusiast or a newcomer looking for a quick and easy game to pass the time, Buraco is an excellent choice.

In Buraco, players are dealt seven cards each from two standard decks of 54 cards each, including two jokers. The game is played with two players, and the objective is to be the first to get rid of all your cards. Buraco is a variation of Canasta that allows both standard melds (groups of cards of the same value) as well as sequences (cards in numerical order in the same suit). This unique blend of gameplay mechanics makes Buraco a challenging and engaging game that will keep players on their toes.
